English: We aim at this study to evaluate the impact of comorbidities in COVID-19 patients on the outcome and determine predictors of prolonged hospital stay, requisite for ICU admission or decease.

Yoruba: Àfojúsùn wa ni láti ṣe àgbéyẹ̀wò ipa ti ọ̀pọ̀ aàrùn ń kó nínú àwọn aláìsàn COVID-19 lórí àbájáde àti mímọ̀ iye ọjọ́ tí wọ́n yóò lò ni ilé-ìwòsàn, bíbéèrè fún ìgbàwọlé fún ICU tàbí òkú.

Zulu: Izimpawu eziyisisekelo ikakhulukazi i-myalgia nezimawu ze-LRT ezifana ne-dyspnea beziphezulu ezigulini ezinezifo ezihambisanayo (P < 0.05).

English: Among different comorbidities 45.4% of CVD cases were admitted in ICU followed by DM cases (40.8%).

English: Also, patients with comorbidities needed invasive mechanical ventilation more than those without comorbidity (31 vs. 10.7%, P<0.001).

Zulu: Futhi, iziguli ezine-comorbidities zidinga umoya omncane wokungena kwemishini ngaphezu kwalawo angenayo i-comorbidity (31 vs. 10.7%, P <0.001).

English: Significant lower frequency of recovery was found in COVID-19 patients with comorbidities (59% vs. 81%, P<0.001) and death rate was significantly higher in cases with comorbidities (P< 0.001).
Luganda: Okuwona kwali wansi nnyo mu balwadde ba COVID-19 abaalina endwadde endala (59% vs.81%, P<0.001) era n’omuwendo gw’abafa gwali waggulu nnyo mu balwadde abaalina endwadde endala (P< 0.001).
Yoruba: Òdiwọ̀n àti ní ìwòsàn fún àwọn tó ní ọlọ́pọ̀ aàrùn tó ní COVID-19 kéré (59% vs.81%, P<0.001) ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ ikú wọ́pọ̀ láàárín àwọn tó ní ọ̀pọ̀ aàrùn (P< 0.001).
Zulu: Izibalo eziphansi zokusinda zitholakale ezigulini ze-COVID-19 eziphethwe ezinye izifo kanyekanye (59% vs.81%, P<0.001) namazinga okufa abephezulu kwabaphethwe ezinye izifo (P<0.001).
Hausa: An sami ƙananan mitar murmurewa a cikin marasa lafiya na COVID-19 tare da cututtuka (59% vs. 81%, P<0.001) kuma adadin mutuwa ya yi girma sosai a cikin lokuta masu kamuwa da cuta  (P< 0.001).
Northern Sotho: Go hweditšwe ditiragalo ya fasana tša pholo ya bolwetši tše di bonalago go balwetši ba COVID-19 bao ba nago le malwetši a go se alafege (59% e bapetšwa le 81%, P<0.001) gomme kelo ya mahu e bile godimo kudu go batho ba malwetši a go se alafege (P<0.001).
Amharic: ጉልህ በሆነ መልኩ ተጓዳኝ-በሽቶች ባሏቸው የኮቪድ-19 ታማሚዎች ላይ አነስተኛ የማገገም ፍጥነት የታየ ሲሆን (59% vs.81%, P<0.001) የሞት መጠን ደግሞ በተለይ ተጓዳኝ-በሽቶች ባሏቸው ኬዞች ላይ ከፍተኛ ነበር (P< 0.001)፡፡

English: The survival rates in cases with pre-existing CVD and neurological diseases were lower than those without disease (P<0.002 and 0.001 respectively).
Luganda: Omuwendo gw’abawona mu balwadde abaasangibwa ne CVD n’endwadde z’obwongo gwali wansi bw’ogeraageranya n’abo abataazirina (P<0.002 ne 0.001 mu busengeke obwo).
Yoruba: Àwọn tí wọ́n wà láyé nínú ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ pẹ̀lú CVD tó ti wà tẹ́lẹ̀ àti àwọn àìsàn ara mìíràn kéré sí àwọn tí kò ní aàrùn kankan (P<0.002 àti 0.001 lẹ́sẹẹsẹ).
Zulu: Amazinga okusinda kwabane-CVD ebikhona ngaphambilini nezifo ezithinta ingqondo nomgogodla abengaphansi kwalabo abangenaso isifo (P<0.002 no-0.001 ngokulandelana).
Hausa: Yawan rayuwa a cikin marasa lafiya da suke da CVD da cututtuka na qwaqwalwa ba su kai waɗanda ba su da cutatuakn ba (P <0.002 da 0.001 bi da bi).
Northern Sotho: Dikelo tša go phologa ga malwetši ao a bego a le gona a CVD le malwetši a megalatšhika di bile fasana go feta bao ba se nago bolwetši (P<0.002 le 0.001 ka go latelana).
Amharic: ከዚህ ቀደም CVD  እና የኒውሮሎጂካዊ በሽታዎች ባሉባቸው ኬዞች የማገገም ሁኔታ በሽታ ከሌለባቸው ሰዎች ጋር ሲነጻጸር አነስተኛ ነበር፡፡ (ይህም በቅደም ተከተል P<0.002 እና 0.001 ነው፡፡)

English: Association of cardiovascular comorbid conditions including hypertension or neurological diseases together with COVID-19 infections carries higher risks of mortality.
Luganda: Okukwanaganya endwadde z’omutima omuli puleesa oba endwadde z’obwongo ne COVID-19 kyongera ku mikisa gy’okufa.

Northern Sotho: Kamano ya malwetši a go se alafege a go amana le ditšhikapelo go akaretša malwetši a haephathenšene le a megalatšhika gammogo le diphetetšo tša COVID-19 di baka dikotsi tša godimo kudu tša mahu.
Amharic: ከፍተኛ የደም ግፊት ወይም ኒዩሮሎጂካዊ በሽታዎችን ጨምሮ የስርአተ ልብ ወቧንቧ ተጓዳኝ-በሽታ ክስተቶች ከኮቪድ-19 ኢንፌክሽኖች ጋር እንድ ላይ ሲከሰቱ የመሞት እድልን ይጨምራሉ፡፡

English: However, other comorbidities such as diabetes mellitus, chronic pulmonary or kidney diseases may also contribute to increased COVID-19 severity.
Luganda: Wabula, endwadde endala nga sukaali, endwadde z’amawuggwe oba ez’ensigo nazo ziyinza okwongera ku bunyiinyiitivu bwa COVID-19.
Yoruba: Wàyí, àwọn ọlọ́pọ̀ aàrùn bí I ìtọ̀ ṣúgà, ajẹmọ́ ẹ̀dọ̀fórá ọlọ́jọ́ pípẹ́ tàbí àarùn kíndìnrín lè fá kí agbára COVID-19 pọ̀ si.
Zulu: Nokho ke, ezinye izifo eziphathana kanyekanye njengesifo sikashukela, izifo zamaphaphu noma zezinso zingaba nomthelela wikwenza i-COVID-19 igulise kakhulu.
Hausa: Koyaya, wasu cututtuka irin su ciwon sukari, cututtukan huhu ko na qoda na iya ba da gudummawa ga haɓakar COVID-19.
Northern Sotho: Le ge go le bjalo, malwetši a go se alafege a go swana le twetšiswikiri, bolwetši bja go amana le maswafo le bolwetši bja dipshio le ona a ka oketša bošoro bjo bo gaketšego bja COVID-19.
Amharic: ነገር ግን እንደ ስኳር በሽታ፣ ስር የሰደደ ፕልሞናሪ ወይም የኩላሊት በሽታዎችን የመሰሉ ሌሎች ተጓዳኝ-በሽቶች ለኮቪድ-19 መባባስ አስተዋጽኦ ሊያደርጉ ይችላሉ፡፡

English: This study reported that COVID-19 patients who had other diseases like hypertension, diabetes, lung, kidney and heart diseases were at more risk of severe illness, and these patients needed special care in hospitals.
Luganda: Okunoonyereza kuno kwategeeza nti abalwadde ba COVID-19 abaalina endwadde endala nga puleesa, sukaali, endwadde z’amawuggwe, ensigo n’omutima baalina obulabe bungiko obw’okulwala ennyo, era abalwadde bano baali beetaaga obujjanjabi obw’enjawulo mu malwaliro.
Yoruba: Ìwádìí fihàn pé aláìsàn COVID-19 tó ní àìsàn mìíràn bí i ẹ̀jẹ̀ ríru, ìtọ̀ ṣúgà, ọ̀fun, kíndìnrín àti àìsàn ọkàn wọ́n wà ní inù ewu àti ní àìsàn tó le, wọ́n sì nílò ìtọ́jú tó péye ní ilé ìwòsàn.
Zulu: Lolu cwaningo lubike ukuth iziguli ze-COVID-19 ebezinezinye izifo ezifana nephika, ushukela, ezamaphaphu, ezezinso nezifo zenhliziyo, bezisengozini yokuthola izifo ezinzima, futhi lezi ziguli bezidinga ukunakekelwa okukhethekile ezibhedlela.
Hausa: Wannan binciken ya ba da rahoton cewa marasa lafiya na COVID-19 da ke da wasu cututtuka kamar hauhawar jini, ciwon sukari, huhu, koda da cututtukan zuciya sun fi fuskantar haɗarin rashin lafiya mai tsanani, kuma waɗannan marasa lafiya suna buƙatar kulawa ta musamman a asibitoci.
Northern Sotho: Dinyakišišo tše di begile gore balwetši ba COVID-19 bao ba bilego le malwetši a mangwe a bjalo ka haephathenšene, bolwetši bja swikiri, malwetši a maswafo, a dipshio le a pelo ba bile kotsing ye kgolo ya go swarwa ke malwetši a šoro, le gore balwetši ba ba be ba hloka tlhokomelo ya go ikgetha ka dipetlele.
Amharic: ይሄ ጥናት ሪፖርት እንዳደረገው እንደ ከፍተኛ የደም ግፊት፣ የስኳር በሽታ፣ የሳንባ፣ የኩላሊት እና የልብ በሽታ አይነት ሌሎች በሽታዎች ያሉባቸው የኮቪድ-19 ታማሚዎች የከፉ በሽታዎችን የመታመም አደጋቸው የበለጠ ከፍተኛ ስለሆነ በሆስፒታሎች ውስጥ ለየት ያለ እንክብካቤ አስፈልጓቸው ነበር፡፡

English: Generally it is difficult and expensive to treat and care for patients with more than one disease or condition.
Luganda: Okutwaliza awamu, kizibu era kya buseere okujjanjaba n’okulabirira abalwadde abalina endwadde oba embeera esukka mu emu.
Yoruba: Ní àkótán, ó lẹ ó sì wọ́n láti tọ́jú aláìsàn tóní jú aàrun kan lọ.
Zulu: Ngenjwayelo kunzima futhi kuyabiza ukwelapha nokunakekela iziguli ezinezifo eziningi.
Hausa: Gabaɗaya dai yana da wuya da tsada a yi wa marasa lafiya magani ko kula da su in suna da cututtuka fiye da ɗaya.
Northern Sotho: Ka kakaretšo go boima ebile go bitša tšhelete ye ntši go alafa le go hlokomela balwetši bao ba nago le bolwetši bja go feta botee.
Amharic: በጥቅሉ ከአንድ በላይ በሽታ ወይም ኮንዲሽን ያላቸውን ታማሚዎች ማከም ከባድ እና ውድ ነው፡፡

English: These other underlying diseases or conditions are also referred to as comorbidities.
Luganda: Endwadde oba embeera zino endala era ze zoogerwako ng’okubeera n’endwadde endala.
Yoruba: Ọlọ́pọ̀ aàrun ní wón pe àwọn tó ní aàrùn abẹ́lẹ̀ tàbí ipò.
Zulu: Lezi ezinye izifo ezicashile nazo zibizwa ngezifo eziphathana kanyekanye.
Hausa: Waxannan qarin cututtuka ko yanayi kuma ana kiran su da haxakar cututtuka.
Northern Sotho: Malwetši a a mangwe a kotsi goba go se ipshine mmeleng le ona a bitšwa gore ke malwetši a go se alafege.
Amharic: እነዚህ ሌሎች ወይም ተጓዳኝ በሽታዎች በአጠቃላይ ተጓዳኝ-በሽቶች ይታወቃሉ፡፡

English: Doctors report that even COVID-19 disease is worsened in patients with comorbidities.
Luganda: Abasawo bagamba nti n’obulwadde bwa COVID-19 bweyongera mu balwadde abalina endwadde endala.
Yoruba: Àwọn dókítà jábọ̀ pe aàrun COVID-19 máa ń peléke si í lára àwọn olọ́pọ̀ aàrùn.
Zulu: ODokotela babika ukuthi ne-COVID-19 ihlupha kakhulu ezigulini ezinezinye izifo.
Hausa: Likitoci sun ba da rahoton cewa ko da cutar COVID-19 ta yi muni a cikin marasa lafiya da ke fama da wasu cutukan da ke qara mata qaimi.
Northern Sotho: Dingaka di bega gore le bjona bolwetši bja COVID-19 bo a gakala go batho bao ba nago le malwetši a go se alafege.
Amharic: ተጓዳኝ-በሽቶች  ባሏቸው ታማሚዎች ላይ ኮቪድ-19ም እንደሚባባስ ዶክተሮቹ ሪፖርት ያደርጋሉ፡፡

English: The COVID-19 pandemic, which began in 2020, killed many people worldwide and hospitals were short of ICU beds for critical patients.
Luganda: Nawookeera wa COVID-19, eyatandika mu 2020, yatta abantu bangi okwetooloola ensi era amalwaliro gaggweebwako ebitanda by’abayi eby’abalwadde abali obubi ennyo.
Yoruba: Àjàkáyé aàrun COVID-19, èyí tó bẹ̀rẹ̀ ní ọdún 2020, pa ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ ènìyàn lágbàáyé àti wí pé àwọn ilé ìwosàn kò ní béèdì ICU fú àwọn aláìsàn.
Zulu: Impathamhlaba i-COVID-19, eyaqala ngo-2020 ibulale abantu abaningi emhlabenu wonke futhi izibhedlela zazishoda ngemibhede yase-ICU yeziguli ezazigula kakhulu.
Hausa: Annobar cutar COVID-19, wacce ta fara a cikin 2020, ta kashe mutane da yawa a duk duniya kuma asibitoci sun gaza gadaje ICU ga marasa lafiya masu mahimmanci.
Northern Sotho: Leuba la COVID-19, leo le thomilego ka 2020, le bolaile batho ba bantši lefaseng ka bophara le gona dipetlele di be di hloka mepete ya ICU go balwetši bao ba lwalago kudu.
Amharic: በ2020 የጀመረው የኮቪድ-19 ወረርሽኝ በአለም ዙሪያ ብዙ ሰዎችን የገደለ ሲሆን፣ ሆስፒታሎች በጣም ከፍተኛ አደጋ ላይ ለነበሩ ታማሚዎች የአይሲዩ እና የአልጋ እጥረት ነበረባቸው፡፡ እጥረት ነበረባቸው፡፡

English: For this reason, doctors were looking for ways to quickly identify patients who would need to be admitted in ICU.
Luganda: Olw’ensonga eno, abasawo baali banoonya engeri y’okuzuulamu amangu abalwadde abandyetaaze okussibwa mu busenge bw’abayi.
Yoruba: Fún ìdí èyí, àwọn d́okítà ń wá ọ̀nà àti tètè mọ àwọn aláìsàn tó yẹ kí wọ́n wà ní ICU.
Zulu: Ngenxa yalesi sizathu, odokotela bebebheka izindlela zokushesha babone iziguli ezidinga ukulaliswa e-ICU.
Hausa: A saboda wannan dalili, likitoci suna neman hanyoyin da za a hanzarta gano marasa lafiya waɗanda ke buƙatar shigar da su a cikin ICU.
Northern Sotho: Ka lebaka le, dingaka di be di nyakana le ditsela tša go hlaola ka pela balwetši bao ba ka hlokago go amogelwa go ICU.
Amharic: በዘህም ምክንያት ዶክተሮቹ በአስቸኳይ ወደ አይሲዩ መግባት ያለባቸውን ታማሚዎች በፍጥነት ለይተው የሚያውቁበትን መንገድ እየፈለጉ ነበር፡፡

English: In this study, researchers assessed how comorbidities really affected COVID-19 patients.
Luganda: Mu kunoonyereza kuno, abanoonyereza beetegereza engeri okubeera n’endwadde ezisukka mu emu gye kyakosaamu abalwadde ba COVID-19.
Yoruba: Nínú ìwádìí yìí, àwọn aṣèwàdìí ṣe àwárí bí àwọn ọlọpọ̀ àìsàn ṣe ní ipa lórí àwọn alárùn COVID-19.
Zulu: Kulolu cwaningo, abacwaningi bahlolisise ukuthi lezi zifo eziphathana kanyekanye beziziphatha kanjani iziguli ezine-COVID-19.
Hausa: A cikin wannan binciken, masu bincike sun tantance yadda haxakar cutuka ya shafi masu cutar COVID-19.
Northern Sotho: Ka dinyakišišong tše, banyakišiši ba lekotše ka moo malwetši a go se alafege a tlogilego a ama balwetši ba COVID-19.
Amharic: በዚህ ጥናት ተመራማሪዎች ተጓዳኝ-በሽቶች በኮቪድ-19 ታማሚዎች ላይ በእርግጠኝነት ምን አይነት ተጽእኖዎችን እንደሚያደርሱ መርምረዋል፡፡

English: They also looked into factors that could lead to patients staying in hospital for a long time, being admitted to ICU, or dying from COVID-19.
Luganda: Era baatunula mu nsonga endala eziyinza okuviirako abalwadde okulwa ennyo mu ddwaliro, okussibwa mu busenge bw’abayi, oba okufa olwa COVID-19.
Yoruba: Bẹ́ẹ̀ náà ni wọ́n wo àwọn nǹkan tí ó lè fà á kí aláìsàn wà ní ilé-ìwòsàn fún ọjọ́ pípẹ́, gbígbà sí ICU tàbí ikú látàrí aàrùn COVID-19.
Zulu: Babheke nezimbangela ezingaholela ezigulini ezilala esibhedlela isikhathi eside, zilele e-ICU, noma zibulawe i-COVID-19.
Hausa: Sun kuma duba abubuwan da za su iya haifar da marasa lafiya su zauna a asibiti na dogon lokaci, shigar da su ICU, ko kuma su mutu daga COVID-19.
Northern Sotho: Ba lebeletše le dintlha tšeo di ka hlolago gore balwetši ba dule dipetlele nako e telele, ba amogelwe go ICU, goba ba hlokofale ka lebaka la COVID-19.
Amharic: በተጨማሪም ታማሚዎች ለረጅም ጊዜ ሆስፒታል ውስጥ እንዲቆዩ፣ ወደ አይሲዩ እንዲገቡ ወይም በኮቪድ-19 እንዲሞቱ ሊዳርጓቸው የሚችሉትን ምክንያቶች ፈትሸዋል፡፡

English: The researchers observed COVID-19 positive adults admitted in the 2 biggest hospitals in Egypt, and checked their health records for demographic data, laboratory tests results and chest X-ray results.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza beetegereza abantu abakulu abalina COVID-19 abaaweebwa ebitanda mu malwaliro 2 agasinga obunene mu Egypt, ne bakebera ebiwandiiko byabwe eby’ekisawo okumanya ebibakwatako, ebyava mu kubakebera mu magezeserezo n’ebyava mu kubakuba ebifaananyi mu kifuba.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí ṣe àkíyèsi àwọn àgbàlagbà tó ni COVID-19 tí wọ́n gbà sí ilé-ìwòsàn 2 tó tóbi jù ní Egypt, àti wíwo àkòsílẹ̀ ìlẹra fún data àwọn ènìyàn, èsì ìdánwò lááàbù, àti èsì fótò àyà.
Zulu: Abacwaningi baqaphe abantu abadala abane- COVID-19 abalaliswe ezibhedlela ezi-2 ezinkulu eGibhithe, bahlola namarekhodi abo ezempilo ukuze bethole eminye imininingwane, imiphumela yaselabhorethri nama-X-ray ezifuba.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun lura da COVID-19 manya masu inganci da aka shigar a cikin manyan asibitoci 2 a Masar, kuma sun bincika bayanan lafiyar su don bayanan alƙaluma, sakamakon gwaje-gwajen dakin gwaje-gwaje da sakamakon X-ray na kirji.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba beile leihlo batho ba bagolo ba COVID-19 bao ba amogetšwego dipetleleng tše kgolo tše 2 go la Egepeta, le go lekodišiša dipego tša bona tša maphelo go hwetša tshedimošo ya motheo, dipoelo tša diteko tša laporathori le dipoelo tša X-rei ya kgara.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ በግብጽ በሚገኙት 2ቱ ትልልቅ ሆስፒታሎች ውስጥ ለህክምና የገቡትን የኮቪድ-19 ታማሚ አዋቂዎች  የቃኙ ሲሆን፣  የጤና ረኮርዳቸውን፣ የህዝበ ነክ ጥናት መረጃቸውን እና የላብራቶሪ እና የደረት ኤክስሬይ (ራጅ) ውጤታቸውን ፈትሸዋል፡፡

English: They also recorded whether the patient completely recovered, was admitted in ICU, or died.
Luganda: Era baawandiika oba omulwadde yawonera ddala, yassibwa mu kasenge k’abayi, oba yafa.
Yoruba: Wọ́n ṣe àkọsílẹ̀ bọ́yá wọ́n gbà aláìsàn tí ara rẹ̀ yá sí ICU tàbí ó kú.
Zulu: Baphide babhala ukuthi isiguli sisindile ngokuphelele, sifakwe e-ICU, noma sifile.
Hausa: Sun kuma rubuta ko mara lafiyar ya murmure gaba ɗaya, an shigar da shi a cikin ICU, ko ya mutu.
Northern Sotho: Ba begile le ge e ba molwetši yo a foletšego sa ruri, o amogetšwe go ICU, goba o hlokofetše.
Amharic: በተጨማሪም ታማሚዎቹ ሙሉ በሙሉ ማገገማቸውን፣ አይሲዩ እንዲገቡ መደረጋቸውን ወይም መሞታቸውን ሪኮርድ አድርገዋል፡፡

English: The researchers compared the results for patients with comorbidities to those without.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baageraageranya ebyavaamu eby’abalwadde abaalina endwadde endala n’eby’abo abataalina.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí ṣe àfiwéra èsì àyẹ̀wò ọlọ́pọ̀ aàrùn àti àwọn tí kò ní.
Zulu: Abacwaningi baqhathanise imiphumela yeziguli ezinezinye izifo nalezi ezingenazo.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun kwatanta sakamakon ga marasa lafiya tare da cututtuka da wadanda ba tare da su ba.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba bapeditše dipoelo tša balwetši ba malwetši a go se alafege le tša bao ba se nago ona.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ ተጓዳኝ-በሽቶች ያሏቸውን ታማሚዎች ከሌላቸው ታማሚዎች ጋር አወዳድረዋል፡፡

English: The study found that over half of the patients had comorbidities, with heart disease and diabetes being the most common.
Luganda: Okunoonyereza kwakizuula nti abalwadde abasukka mu kimu kyakubiri baalina endwadde endala, ng’endwadde z’omutima ne sukaali ze zaali zisinga.
Yoruba: Ìwádìí fihàn pé ó kọjá Ìdá méjì àwọn aláìsan tí wọ́n ní ọpọ̀ àìsàn pẹ̀lú aàrùn ọkàn àti ìtọ̀ ṣúgà ló wọ́pọ̀ jù.
Zulu: Ucwaningo kuthothele ukuthi iziguli ezingaphezu kukahhafu bezinezinye izifo, isifo senhliziyo noshukela bezihamba phambili.
Hausa: Binciken ya gano cewa fiye da rabin marasa lafiya suna da cututtuka, tare da cututtukan zuciya da ciwon sukari sun fi yawa.
Northern Sotho: Dinyakišišo di laeditše gore balwetši bao ba fetago seripagare ba be ba na le malwetši a go se alafege, ao a sepelago mmogo le bolwetši bja pelo le bolwetši bja swikiri.
Amharic: ጥናቱ እንዳገኘው የልብ እና የስኳር በሽታዎች ዋነኞቹ ሆነው ከግማሽ በላይ የሚሆኑት ተማሚዎች ተጓዳኝ-በሽቶች ነበሩባቸው፡፡

English: Patients with comorbidities had worse laboratory results, and were less likely to recover from COVID-19.
Luganda: Abalwadde abalina endwadde endala baafuna ebiva mu kukeberwa ebibi, era baali tebasuubirwa kuwona COVID-19.
Yoruba: Àwọn ọlọ́pọ̀ àìsàn kò ní èsì láaàbù tó dáa àti wí pé wọ́n lè má ye àìsàn COVID-19.
Zulu: Iziguli ezinezinye izifo kanyekanye zibe nemiphumela yaselabhorethri emibi, futhi bezisemathubeni aphansi okusinda ku-COVID-19.
Hausa: Marasa lafiya da ke fama da cututtuka sun sami mummunan sakamakon dakin gwaje-gwaje, kuma ba su da yuwuwar murmurewa daga COVID-19.
Northern Sotho: Balwetši ba malwetši a go se alafege ba bile le dipoelo tša laporathori tše di sa kgahlišego, le gona go sa tshephiše gore ba ka fola go COVID-19.
Amharic: ተጓዳኝ-በሽቶች ያሉባቸው ታማሚዎች የከፋ የላብራቶሪ ውጤቶች የነበራቸው ሰሆን፣ ከኮቪድ-19 የማገገም አድላቸው እጅግ አነስተኛ ነበር፡፡

English: Again, patients with comorbidities, especially heart diseases or diabetes, were most likely to be admitted in ICU and needed help with breathing.
Luganda: Ekirala, abalwadde abaalina endwadde endala, naddala endwadde z’omutima oba sukaali, baalina emikisa mingi egy’okussibwa mu busenge bw’abayi era baali beetaaga obuyambi mu kussa.
Yoruba: Bákan náà, àwọn aláìsà tí wọ́n ní ọ̀pọ̀ aàrùn bí àìsàn ọkàn tàbí ìtọ̀ ṣúgà, ó ṣe é ṣe kí wọ́n gbà wọ́n sí ICU kí wọ́n sì nílò ìrànlọ́wọ́ láti mí.
Zulu: Futhi, iziiguli ezinezinye izifo, ikakhulukazi izifo zenhliziyo noma isifo sashukela, bezisengcupheni yokulaliswa e-ICU ephezulu futhi bezidinga usizo lokuphefumula.
Hausa: Bugu da ƙari, marasa lafiya masu cututtuka, musamman cututtukan zuciya ko ciwon sukari, sun fi dacewa a shigar da su a cikin ICU kuma suna buƙatar taimako tare da numfashi.
Northern Sotho: Gape, balwetši ba malwetši a go se alafege, kudukudu malwetši a pelo goba bolwetši bja swikiri, ke bao ba bego ba ka amogelwa ka bontši go ICU ebile ba hloka thušo ya go hema.
Amharic: በተጨማሪ ተጓዳኝ-በሽቶች ያሏቸው ታማሚዎች በተለየም የልብ እና የስኳር በሽተኞች ወደ አይሲዩ የመግባት እድላቸው እጅግ ከፍተኛ ከመሆኑ ባሻገር መተንፈስ እንዲችሉ እገዛ አስፈልጓቸው ነበር፡፡

English: Results also showed that the elderly were more likely to die from COVID-19.
Luganda: Ebyavaamu era byalaga nti abakadde baalina emikisa mingi egy’okufa COVID-19.
Yoruba: Èsì tún fihàn pé àwọn arúgbó ni ó ṣe e ṣe kí wọ́n tètè kú látàrí COVID-19.
Zulu: Imiphumela iveze nokuthi asebekhule kakhulu bebesengcupheni yokubulawa i-COVID-19.
Hausa: Sakamakon ya kuma nuna cewa tsofaffi suna iya mutuwa daga COVID-19.
Northern Sotho: Dipoelo di bontšhitše le gore go be go na le kgonagalo ye ntši ya gore batho ba bagolo ba ka hlokofala ka lebaka la COVID-19.
Amharic: ውጤቶቹ በተለይም በእድሜ የገፉ ሰዎች በኮቪድ-19 የመሞት እድላቸው ከፍተኛ እንደሆነ አሳይተዋል፡፡

English: Of all the comorbidities studied here, researchers found that heart disease, hypertension and diabetes were the most risky, and linked this to old age.
Luganda: Ku ndwadde zonna endala ezaanoonyerezebwako, abanoonyereza bakizuula nti endwadde y’omutima, puleesa ne sukaali ze zaali zisinga okuba ez’obulabe, era nga kino baakikwanaganya na bukadde.
Yoruba: Nínú gbogbo ìwádìí nípa ọlọ́pọ̀ aàrùn, àwọn aṣèwádìí ṣe àwárí pé àìsàn ọkàn, ẹ̀jẹ̀ ríru àti ìtọ̀ ṣugà ló ní ewu jù, èyí sì ní ṣẹ pẹ̀lú ogbó.
Zulu: Kuzo zonke izifoeziphathana kanyekanye ezicwaningwe lapha, abacwaningi bathole ukuthi isifo senhliziyo, iphika noshukela, beziyingozi kakhulu, lokhu bakuhlanganise nokuguga.
Hausa: A cikin dukkan cututtukan da aka yi nazari a nan, masu bincike sun gano cewa cututtukan zuciya, hauhawar jini da ciwon sukari sune mafi haɗari, kuma suna danganta hakan da tsufa.
Northern Sotho: Go malwetši ka moka a go se alafege ao a go nyakišišitšwego ka ona mo, banyakišiši ba utollotše gore bolwetši bja pelo, haephathenšene le bolwetši bja swikiri e bile a šoro kudu, ebile a amantšhwa se le botšofadi.
Amharic: እዚህ ከተጠኑት ተጓዳኝ-በሽቶች ሁሉ ተመራማሪዎቹ እንዳገኙት ፣የልብ ህመም፣ ከፍተኛ የደም ግፊት እና የስኳር በሽታ በጣም አስጊዎቸ ነበሩ፤ ከእድሜ መግፋት ወይም ከማርጀት ጋርም ተያይዘዋል፡፡

English: The researchers did not see any link between diabetes and the death of COVID-19 patients.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza tebaalabawo kakwate konna wakati wa sukaali n’okufa kw’abalwadde ba COVID-19.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí kò rí ìjámọ́ra láàárín ìtọ̀ ṣúgà àti ikú àwọn alárùn COVID-19.
Zulu: Abacwaningi abakubonanga ukuxhumana phakathi kwesifo sashukela nokufa kweziguli ze-COVID-19.
Hausa: Masu binciken ba su ga wata alaƙa tsakanin ciwon sukari da mutuwar masu cutar COVID-19 ba.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ga se ba bona kamano efe goba efe magareng ga bolwetši bja swikiri le go hlokafala ga balwetši ba COVID-19.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ በስኳር በሽታ እና በኮቪድ-19 በሽተኞች መሞት ላይ ምንም አይነት ግንኙነት አላገኙም፡፡

English: Previous studies had reported possible effects of underlying diseases, and this study confirmed that indeed multiple comorbidities increase COVID-19 disease risk and contribute to worse outcomes.
Luganda: Okunoonyereza okw’emabega kwali kwalaga ebiyinza okuleetebwa endwadde omuntu z’asangiddwa nazo, era okunoonyereza kuno kwakakasa nti mu butuufu okubeera n’endwadde endala kyongera ku bulabe bw’obulwadde bwa COVID-19 era ziviirako obuzibu obw’amaanyi.
Yoruba: Àwọn ìwádìí tí wọ́n ṣe kọjá jabọ̀ àwọn ipa ti ó ṣe é ṣe kí aàrùn ní, ìwádìí yìí sì ti fòǹtẹ̀ lù ú pé ọ̀pọ̀ aàrùn máa jẹ́ kí ewu aàrùn COVID-19 lẹ́ kan sí i, ó sì máa ń fa ìbájáde tó burú.
Zulu: Ucwaningo lwangaphambilini lubike imithelela yezifo ezicashile, lolu cwaningo lwaqinisekisa ukuthi izifo eziphathana kanyekanye eziningi zinyusa ubungozi be-COVID-19 zidale imiphumela emibi.
Hausa: Nazarin da suka gabata sun ba da rahoton yuwuwar tasirin cututtukan da ke cikin ƙasa, kuma wannan binciken ya tabbatar da cewa haƙiƙa ƙwayoyin cuta da yawa suna haɓaka haɗarin cutar COVID-19 kuma suna ba da gudummawa ga sakamako mafi muni.
Northern Sotho: Dinyakišišo tša peleng di begile ka ga ditlamorago tše di ka bago gona tša malwetši a šoro, gomme dinyakišišo tše di tiišeditše gore ka nnete malwetši a mantši a go se alafege a oketša kotsi ya malwetši a COVID-19 le go ba le seabe go dipoelo tše di sa thabišego.
Amharic: ከዚህ በፊት የተደረጉ ጥናቶች የተጓዳኝ በሽቶች ተጽእኖ ሊሆኑ የሚችሉ ነገሮችን ሪፖርት ያደረጉ ሲሆን፣ ይሄ ጥናት ብዙ ተጓዳኝ-በሽቶች የኮቪድ-19 በሽታ አደጋን እንደሚጨምሩ እና ለከፉ ውጤቶች እንደሚዳርጉ አረጋግጧል፡፡

English: The researchers say that the results of this study might be limited because only a few of their patients had comorbidities of chronic liver, kidney, metabolic, neurological, endocrine, and autoimmune diseases.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza bagamba nti ebyava mu kunoonyereza kuno biyinza okuba nga tebituukiridde kubanga abalwadde batono abaalina endwadde endala ez’ekibumba, ensigo, endwadde ezeekuusa ku mmere, ez’obwongo, ezeekuusa ku homoni, n’ez’obusibage okulwanyisa obutaffaali obulamu.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí sọ pé ìdíwọ́ máa wà fún ìwádìí yìí nítorí ọ̀pọ̀ àwọn aláìsàn wọn ni ó Ọ̀pọ̀ aàrùn ẹ̀dọ̀ ọlọ́jọ́ pípẹ́, kíndìnrín, ìyòrò, aàrùn àjẹ́mọ́ ọpọlọ, endocrine, àti àìsàn agbogun-tira-ẹṅi.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathi imiphumela yalolu cwaningo ayanele ngoba bezimbalwa iziguli zabo ebezinezinye izifo zesibindi, zezinso, zokusebenza komzimba, zengqondo nomgogodla, i-endocrine nezifo ezihlasela amasosha omzimba.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun ce sakamakon wannan binciken na iya iyakancewa saboda kaɗan ne kawai daga cikin majiyyatan su ke da cututtukan hanta, koda, metabolism, neurological, endocrine, da cututtukan autoimmune.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba bolela gore dipoelo tša dinyakišišo tše di ka ba le bosodi ka gore ke balwetši ba mmalwa fela bao ba bego ba na le malwetši a go se alafege ao a amanago le malwetši ao a sa folego a sebete, pshio, methapoliki, megalatšhika, entokheraene, le malwetši a go itlhasela ga mašole e mmele.
